abstract.t:
This document specifies an IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX) profile for exporting buffer occupancy snapshots. It separates the number of objects selected for acquisition, the number successfully captured, and the number of distinct object records validated by a collector. A capture span bounds the temporal separation of the reported measurements.
The profile defines ten Information Elements, object identity and accounting rules, and an ordered export procedure in which final metadata closes a snapshot. The resulting collector procedure uses bounded state and distinguishes partial acquisition from incomplete delivery. It does not define a buffer implementation, a trigger configuration protocol, or a congestion control algorithm.
